reference: M. Guasoni, 'Generalized modulational instability in multimode fibers: wideband parametric amplification', Phys. Rev. A 92, 033849 (2015), doi:10.1103/PhysRevA.92.033849

fiber.type: circular step-index MMF, ideally isotropic (no mode coupling, no degeneracy splitting of LP11/LP21)
fiber.V_typo_note: paper p-04 text prints 'n_clad = 1.5 and n_core = 1.5035' but assigns n_clad the larger value; V~5 confirms the roles are as written here (read back from pages/p-04.png). The planned README had also transposed the beta2/beta3 columns of Table I; corrected here against pages/p-05.png.
fiber.loss: zero (paper Sec. III; losses analyzed separately in the paper's Sec. VII via a truncated Magnus expansion, out of scope)
fiber.gamma_11_note: C_11 = 10 W^-1 km^-1 defines the reproduction's gamma scale; all Table II entries are C_kn/C_11

bimodal_coefficients.page_refs: p-03 (definitions). With a purely x-polarized input (|p_ny| = 0) all b_X and b_perp contributions to the x-sector vanish; the y-polarized sideband sub-matrix decouples and gains nothing (paper pinpoints its own Â_ny analysis as 'not considered').

table_I_modes.note: paper text: propagated as 1x/2x/3x/4x; note LP01 beta2=+21.7 ps^2/km (normal!), LP02=-147.7, LP11=+36.3, LP21=-3.5; the planned README had the LP11/LP21 columns swapped, and also had GVM=13.6 vs the LP02 10.8 ps/m convention, both corrected.

table_II_C_over_gamma11.shape: C_kn/C_11, row k = output sideband mode 1..4, col n = pump mode 1..4

pump.pump_phases: psi_nx(0) = 0 for all modes (real cw amplitudes, |p_nx| = sqrt(1000 W))
pump.characteristic_time_note: T_NL,1 = (beta2_1x * L_NL,1 / 2)^0.5 = (21.7 ps^2/km * 0.1 m / 2)^0.5 = 32.9 fs; paper quotes 30.1 THz for nu=1 (0.9 %), consistent

noise_seed.paper: weak white background noise r_nx(0,t) added on top of each modal cw pump, per-frequency-sample Gaussian real+imag (paper Sec. III page refs: p-04)
noise_seed.note: paper never fixes the absolute seed level; Eq. (12) is a log-ratio so only relative spectra matter; the SSFM here seeds every nx mode identically with per-sample power 1e-7 W (total 4e-7 W), far below amplified band amplitude after L = 5..16 m and negligible against the cw pump per mode

comparison_anchors: Fig. 2b: conventional/secondary bands labelled B_A..B_D (zoom 0.85..1.1); Fig. 2c: zoom 0..0.65 with B_G..B_J
Fig. 4/5/6 amplification factors: Fig. 4b (L=5, nu in 0..0.65) dominant band ~0.64 (B_G - 0.07); Fig. 5 (L=16, same band) dominant band ~0.69 (B_F - 0.21); Fig. 6 similar for 4x with ~0.67 peak

engine_model.coef_model: isotropic (all-ones) with explicit xpm_weights = C matrix (Mumtaz Eq.-8-style per-pair weights), include_fwm=True, fwm_weights = C tensor (Mumtaz Eq. 8 / Eq. 6 geometry)
engine_model.html_note: the split-step engine implements the SPM + intermodal XPM scalar-coupled cubic exactly (b_S=1 diag, b_||=2 for k != n), matching the paper's Eq. (3) HiBi form substituted with the isotropic b_S/b_parallel values; the amplitude amplification factors and two-mode MI bands emerge automatically
engine_model.include_fwm_note: the paper's linearized MI eigen-matrix (Eq. 8/9) is the exact linearization of the Eq. (3) cubic; the engine's separate `_fwm_rhs` handles the A_n^2 A_q* intermodal FWM for the Mumtaz/paper's 1207.6645v1 (also Eq. 6 of Guasoni Eq. 2 structure), which is REQUIRED: without it the noise-seed spectra satisfy only the SPM/XPM flow whose linearized matrix lacks the intermodal (n != m off-diagonal) 2x2 parametric coupling that produces the multimode gain bands
engine_model.pump_depletion: off (paper uses undepleted-pump approximation; lossless; uniform 1000 W/mode cw keeps |p_na| constant beyond noise floor)

fig2_note: Fig. 2 (gain-mapping of Eq. 8 at 1550 nm, four-panel version) is the qualitative target; Fig. 3 dots are the quantitative anchors for the matrix build
